# Ozford Institute of Higher Education (OIHE)

> Ozford Institute of Higher Education (OIHE) is a registered Australian higher education provider with over 23 years of academic excellence. The institution is based in the heart of Melbourne, Victoria, Australia, with a new campus opening in Brisbane, Queensland in August 2026. OIHE offers globally recognised undergraduate and postgraduate degrees, primarily designed to connect international and domestic students with industry-relevant skills and career-ready qualifications. The institute has produced 1,500+ graduates and is committed to small class sizes, personalised learning, and strong student support services.

- **Full Name:** Ozford Institute of Higher Education (OIHE)
- **Also Known As:** OIHE, Ozford
- **Website:** https://ozford.edu.au/
- **Campus 1:** Melbourne, VIC, Australia (main campus — city centre)
- **Campus 2:** Brisbane, QLD, Australia (opening August 2026)
- **Phone:** +61 3 8663 7188
- **Admissions Email:** admissions@ozford.edu.au
- **General Email:** info@ozford.edu.au
- **Provider Type:** Australian Higher Education Institution
- **Regulatory Body:** TEQSA (Tertiary Education Quality and Standards Agency)
- **CRICOS Registered:** Yes — accepts international students on student visas
- **ESOS Compliant:** Yes — governed by the Education Services for Overseas Students (ESOS) Act
- **Student LMS:** Moodle (https://oihe.ozford.edu.au)

---

## About Ozford Institute of Higher Education

Ozford Institute of Higher Education is an innovative Australian educational institution dedicated to bridging today's learning with tomorrow's jobs. Located in Melbourne's city centre, students benefit from proximity to educational facilities, business districts, sporting venues, and cultural attractions. OIHE is known for small class sizes (allowing personalised academic attention), a supportive student community, modern campus facilities including a library, student common areas, and a career hub to support graduate employment outcomes.

OIHE accepts both domestic and international students. Domestic students include Australian and New Zealand citizens, permanent residents, and holders of permanent humanitarian visas. International students are those intending to study on a student visa or holding temporary resident status.

---

## Higher Education Courses

OIHE offers higher education qualifications across Information Technology, Business, Accounting, and Cyber Security. All courses are designed to meet Australian Qualifications Framework (AQF) standards.

### Postgraduate Courses

- **Master of Information Technology (MIT)**
  - CRICOS Code: 115641M
  - Level: Postgraduate (Masters)
  - Focus: Leadership and multidisciplinary skills in technology and science; prepares graduates for global technology careers
  - URL: https://ozford.edu.au/study/postgraduate/master-of-information-technology/
  - Brochure: https://ozford.edu.au/documents/1/MIT.pdf

- **Master of Business Administration (MBA)**
  - Level: Postgraduate (Masters)
  - Focus: Business leadership, management strategy, and global business skills
  - URL: https://ozford.edu.au/study/postgraduate/master-of-business-administration/

- **Master of Professional Accounting (MPA)**
  - Level: Postgraduate (Masters)
  - Focus: Professional accounting standards, financial reporting, and CPA pathway
  - URL: https://ozford.edu.au/study/postgraduate/master-of-professional-accounting/

- **Graduate Diploma in Information Technology**
  - Level: Graduate Diploma
  - URL: https://ozford.edu.au/study/postgraduate/graduate-diploma-in-information-technology/

- **Graduate Diploma in Management**
  - Level: Graduate Diploma
  - URL: https://ozford.edu.au/study/postgraduate/graduate-diploma-in-management/

- **Graduate Certificate in Information Technology**
  - Level: Graduate Certificate
  - URL: https://ozford.edu.au/study/postgraduate/graduate-certificate-in-information-technology/

- **Graduate Certificate in Management**
  - Level: Graduate Certificate
  - URL: https://ozford.edu.au/study/postgraduate/graduate-certificate-in-management/

### Undergraduate Courses

- **Bachelor of Cyber Security**
  - Level: Bachelor Degree
  - Focus: Cybersecurity principles, network defence, ethical hacking, and digital forensics
  - URL: https://ozford.edu.au/study/undergraduate/bachelor-of-cyber-security/

- **Bachelor of Information Systems**
  - Level: Bachelor Degree
  - Focus: Systems analysis, software development, and IT project management
  - URL: https://ozford.edu.au/study/undergraduate/bachelor-of-information-systems/

- **Bachelor of Business (Accounting)**
  - Level: Bachelor Degree
  - Focus: Accounting, financial management, and business operations
  - URL: https://ozford.edu.au/study/undergraduate/bachelor-of-business-accounting/

- **Bachelor of Business**
  - Level: Bachelor Degree
  - Focus: Business management, marketing, and entrepreneurship
  - URL: https://ozford.edu.au/study/undergraduate/bachelor-of-business/

- **Diploma of Business**
  - Level: Diploma
  - Focus: Foundation business skills as a pathway to bachelor studies
  - URL: https://ozford.edu.au/study/undergraduate/diploma-of-business/
